permanent_rule: LBFL will not depend on a single guidebook or textbook. Curriculum boundaries will follow NCTB. Explanations will be developed through cross-verification among NCTB-authorized HSC texts and appropriate authoritative scientific references. Every substantial source-dependent claim will identify its reference, and uncertainty or disagreement among sources will be stated rather than silently reconciled.

hierarchy.role: Defines official paper, chapter and topic boundary.
Primary curricular evidence and page-level textbook support.
Cross-checks explanations, examples, diagrams, terminology and alternative authorized treatments.
Clarifies mechanisms, resolves outdated/ambiguous textbook treatment, and supports deeper scientific explanation.
hierarchy.required_when: Textbook treatment is incomplete, disputed, outdated, or scientifically insufficient.

hierarchy.prohibition: Must not substitute for curriculum coverage or textbook/scientific verification.

minimum: at least one authenticated NCTB-authorized HSC textbook source
verified_primary_contract.multi_reference_expectation: Additional authorized books and/or authoritative scientific references should be added where available and are required when a claim is disputed, ambiguous, incomplete, outdated or materially strengthened by cross-verification.
verified_primary_contract.note: verified-primary is a claim-evidence status, not a declaration that one textbook is the sole authority.
